scope: One natural-outcome-derived hypothesis per model, with site/dose comparisons. Completed discovery is not confirmation or general intelligence certification.
caveats: Outcome groups are not paired by topic/difficulty; their contrast is confounded and does not establish a causal looping direction.
Reference-loss improvements select hypotheses only; actual quantized task accuracy can regress.
Native quantization and sampling differ from BF16/vLLM; this is a method adaptation.
Discovery timing can overlap CPU release work; no final speed improvement is claimed.
Candidate and norm-matched random controls are compared on the same frozen cases and seeds.
Final benchmark execution is conditional on independent confirmation. Missing final evidence prevents a replacement claim.
